describe.description: The creature is a large, powerfully built quadrupedal felid shown in right-facing side view with its head turned slightly toward the viewer. It has a robust, muscular body covered in dense, tawny golden-brown fur that is lighter cream-white on the chin, chest, belly and inner legs, with a shaggy ruff of longer fur around the neck and chest. The head is broad and cat-like with a short muzzle, the limbs are thick and sturdy ending in large paws, and a short tail extends from the rear. Faint dark striping is visible over much of the body, most distinctly on the lower legs and hindquarters. The overall impression is of a lion-like and tiger-like cat standing on a plain light background with a soft shadow beneath its feet.

describe.description: A very large, powerfully built four-legged feline shown standing in side view with its head turned toward the viewer. It has short, dense tawny golden-brown fur that is paler whitish on the chest, belly, lower legs and muzzle, with faint dark striping over much of the body. Its build is massive with a broad chest, thick neck with a slight ruff, large broad paws, and a short thin tail with a dark tip. The head is large and rounded with a broad muzzle, dark eyes with white markings below, and small rounded ears.
